source.title: Vesicular GABA Transporter Is Necessary for Transplant-Induced Critical Period Plasticity in Mouse Visual Cortex

confidence_rationale: Causal genetic dissociation: VGAT-null transplanted interneurons migrate and mature normally but FAIL to induce a critical period, while control interneurons do. Directly supports MECH-333's premise that GABAergic (inhibitory) maturation is the trigger that OPENS a time-bounded plasticity window. Mapping fidelity moderate -- biology evidences the opening mechanism, less so REE's specific 'suppress dominant scoring pathway update magnitude' phrasing.
failure_signatures: Transplanted interneurons unable to load GABA into vesicles integrate into the host circuit but do NOT open a plasticity window -- the opening of the window is gated specifically on GABAergic transmission, not merely on the presence of inhibitory cells. The REE analog: simply adding a diversity/inhibitory element is insufficient; it must be functionally transmitting to gate the window open.

Timing of the induced plasticity is dictated by the maturation state of the transplanted GABAergic cells -- the window is yoked to a developmental clock of the inhibitory element, supporting MECH-333's 'time-bounded' framing.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Vesicular GABA transporter (VGAT)-dependent GABAergic transmission by transplanted MGE-derived interneurons is necessary to induce a critical period of ocular-dominance plasticity in mouse visual cortex; VGAT-null interneurons disperse and differentiate normally but fail to open the plasticity window, whose timing tracks the maturation of the transplanted cells.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-333 holds that a time-bounded plasticity-open window must exist during which the dominant (deterministic/scoring) pathway's effective update magnitude is suppressed or the diversity-circuit weight amplified to parity, before winner-take-all capture -- explicitly framed as the REE analog of the GABA-maturation E/I shift that opens biological critical periods. Priya et al. supply direct causal evidence for the biological side of that analogy: functional GABAergic transmission is the necessary trigger that opens the window, and the window is yoked to a developmental clock. This grounds MECH-333's choice of inhibitory/GABA maturation as the gate that opens a bounded plasticity phase.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper evidences the OPENING of a plasticity window by inhibitory maturation; it does not speak to REE's specific mechanism of 'suppressing the dominant scoring pathway's update magnitude' or 'amplifying a diversity circuit to parity'. The mapping is from 'GABA maturation opens the window' (well-supported) to MECH-333's broader winner-take-all-prevention framing (inferred). Mouse visual-cortex ocular dominance -> REE policy/scoring crystallization is a substantial domain transfer.
mapping.source_context: Postnatal mouse visual cortex; heterochronic transplantation of MGE-derived interneuron precursors, wild-type vs VGAT-knockout donors; ocular-dominance plasticity as the readout.

confidence_components.notes: Clean genetic loss-of-function dissociation in a strong venue gives high source quality. Mapping fidelity 0.6: strongly supports the 'inhibitory maturation opens a bounded window' clause but only inferentially the 'suppress dominant pathway / amplify diversity to parity' clause. Transfer risk moderate; ocular-dominance plasticity is the canonical critical-period model.
